# @personaai/sdk 0.7.5

Node.js/TypeScript SDK for [persona.hasanraiyan.me](https://persona.hasanraiyan.me) — Agents, Skills, Knowledge, MCP, Stores, memory, streaming chat **from your own backend**.

> **Server-side only.** `PersonaClient` holds your Project credential — never construct it in a browser bundle or `"use client"` component. See [Integration guide](/guides/integration-guide).

```bash
npm install @personaai/sdk
```

```ts
import { PersonaClient } from '@personaai/sdk';
const persona = new PersonaClient({
  baseUrl: 'https://api.persona.hasanraiyan.me',
  credential: process.env.PERSONA_CREDENTIAL!,
});
const agent = await persona.agents.create({
  name: 'Career Launchpad',
  systemPrompt: 'You help students find internships.',
  providerId: '...',
});
const userClient = new PersonaClient({
  baseUrl: 'https://api.persona.hasanraiyan.me',
  credential: process.env.PERSONA_CREDENTIAL!,
  externalUserId: currentUser.id,
});
for await (const e of userClient.chat.stream(agent._id, { messages: [{ role:'user', content:'Hi' }] })) {
  if(e.type==='TEXT_MESSAGE_CHUNK') process.stdout.write(e.delta);
}
```

## Resources

| Client | Wraps |
| --- | --- |
| `.agents` | `/api/v1/developer/agents` |
| `.skills` | `/api/v1/developer/skills` |
| `.knowledge` | `/api/v1/developer/knowledge` |
| `.mcps` | `/api/v1/developer/mcps` |
| `.threads` | `/api/v1/developer/threads` |
| `.chat` | `/api/v1/developer/agui` |

See [Quickstart](/packages/sdk/v0.7.5/quickstart) and [REST tools](/guides/rest-tools) and [Logging](/guides/integration-guide).

```ts
import { defineRestTool } from '@personaai/sdk/rest-tools';
import { z } from 'zod';
const getProfile = defineRestTool({
  name: 'Get learner profile',
  method: 'GET',
  args: z.object({ userId: z.string() }),
  url: t => `https://api.coursify.dev/users/${t.arg('userId')}`,
});
```
